name: E2E core 1386: declines a haiku
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'write me a haiku about Mondays'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: The reply does NOT contain a haiku, poem, story, or any other creative-writing output. The body of the reply is either a refusal/redirect (e.g. 'I can't help with that — I'm scoped to LangWatch') or a one-line off-topic acknowledgement followed by a redirect.
Langy's reply does not pivot to LangWatch data unrelated to the ask (traces, costs, evaluators or other project results the user did not ask for).
